mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, username, password_hash, real_name, employee_no, mobile, email, organization_id, status, mobile_enabled, must_change_password, last_login_time FROM system_user WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND username = #{username} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT id, tenant_id, username, password_hash, real_name, employee_no, mobile, email, organization_id, status, mobile_enabled, must_change_password, last_login_time FROM system_user WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT r.role_code FROM system_role r INNER JOIN system_user_role ur ON ur.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND ur.role_id = r.id AND ur.deleted = 0 WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0

SELECT DISTINCT m.permission_code FROM system_menu m WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.status = 1 AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.permission_code IS NOT NULL AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM system_user_role admin_relation JOIN system_role admin_role ON admin_role.tenant_id = admin_relation.tenant_id AND admin_role.id = admin_relation.role_id AND admin_role.role_code IN ('ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN') AND admin_role.status = 1 AND admin_role.deleted = 0 WHERE admin_relation.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND admin_relation.user_id = #{userId} AND admin_relation.deleted = 0 ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM system_role_menu rm JOIN system_user_role ur ON ur.tenant_id = rm.tenant_id AND ur.role_id = rm.role_id AND ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.deleted = 0 JOIN system_role r ON r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 WHERE rm.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND rm.menu_id = m.id AND rm.deleted = 0 ) )

SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.parent_id, m.menu_type, m.menu_name, m.route_name, m.route_path, m.component_path, m.permission_code, m.icon, m.sort_order FROM system_menu m WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.status = 1 AND m.visible = 1 AND m.deleted = 0 AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM system_user_role admin_relation JOIN system_role admin_role ON admin_role.tenant_id = admin_relation.tenant_id AND admin_role.id = admin_relation.role_id AND admin_role.role_code IN ('ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN') AND admin_role.status = 1 AND admin_role.deleted = 0 WHERE admin_relation.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND admin_relation.user_id = #{userId} AND admin_relation.deleted = 0 ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM system_role_menu rm JOIN system_user_role ur ON ur.tenant_id = rm.tenant_id AND ur.role_id = rm.role_id AND ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.deleted = 0 JOIN system_role r ON r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 WHERE rm.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND rm.menu_id = m.id AND rm.deleted = 0 ) ) ORDER BY m.sort_order, m.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_login_log (tenant_id, user_id, username, login_ip, user_agent, success, failure_reason, created_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{username}, #{ip}, #{userAgent}, #{success}, #{reason}, COALESCE(#{userId}, 0))
mapper.update: UPDATE system_user SET last_login_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_by = #{userId}, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE system_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, must_change_password = 0, updated_by = #{userId}, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_user (tenant_id, username, password_hash, real_name, organization_id, status, mobile_enabled, must_change_password, created_by, updated_by) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{realName}, ( SELECT id FROM organization WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND parent_id = 0 AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_order, id LIMIT 1 ), 1, 1, 1, 0, 0 )
INSERT INTO system_user_role (tenant_id, user_id, role_id, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{roleId}, #{userId}, #{userId})
